name: timberwalk
description: Timberwalk, Ilderton (Middlesex Centre): the streets of subdivision plan 39T-MC0401 plus Timberwalk Close (39T-MC1901). The default site, chosen by the owner on 2026-09-13.
kind_note: Segment kinds are illustrative, not measured: Timberwalk streets are set to wooded and the neighbouring streets to standard. Nothing in the County data records lot cover, grading or distance to the stormwater pond.
